name: Improved neutron lifetime measurement with UCNτ

summary.plain: UCNtau counted about 38 million surviving ultracold neutrons over two data campaigns in 2017 and 2018 and obtained a neutron lifetime of 877.75 seconds with an uncertainty of about 0.3 seconds. The paper says lifetime experiments can now test refinements of the Standard Model description of neutron decay.
summary.technical: About 38 x 10^6 surviving UCN counted after storage in the magneto-gravitational trap over two campaigns (2017, 2018); three blinded analyses (paired long/short storage runs and a global likelihood fit with the beta-decay lifetime): tau_n = 877.75 ± 0.28 stat +0.22/-0.16 syst s.

title: Improved neutron lifetime measurement with UCNτ
why_it_matters: The abstract says that with this sensitivity, neutron lifetime experiments now directly address the impact of recent refinements in our understanding of the standard model for neutron decay.
